Description.Value: Comprehensive balance overhaul and essential UI enhancements. Features tactical ability rebalancing, weapon/armor adjustments, facility improvements, QoL UI additions, and bug fixes from TFTV and original AA. AAP 1.1: silent no-op fixes (ability costs, armor stats, personal abilities, vehicle ammo, loot, repair costs, Access Lift), configurable options (native ModConfig), and native support for Festering Skies (Behemoth/flyer slowdown) and Corrupted Horizons (Acheron nerf) alongside Kaos Engines. AAP 1.1.2: audit-fix release -- Russian locale + Frenzy config + 25 more fixes (psychic buffs, loot, smart evac, return fire, UI, limited war). Workshop tags should be updated on the Workshop page separately (see Workshop_meta_fix.txt in the release bundle).
